question: Can four original-imaged four-place 明史卷三十五 seasonal 行積度 numbers distinguish the already source-bound G893 six-place post-table prose totals from summing its separately source-bound ordinary printed 行度, using the explicitly conditional matching window?

method_and_firewall.microdegree_scale: All arithmetic carried in exact integer 0.000001 degree; BSB four decimal output compares integer floor((micro+50)/100) for round-half-up; integer floor(micro/100) for truncate-positive. No floating-point or inferred ancient 少/微 definition.
method_and_firewall.hypothetical_alignment: Treat BSB quoted 88/89 and 93/94 elapsed-day rows as G893 ordinary D0...D87/D88 and D0...D92/D93 only FOR THIS TEST; the same table coordinate and unit identity across copies are NOT original-source-proven.
method_and_firewall.reconstruction: For each season and each competing six-place full total, subtract the previously directly printed last ordinary G893 J to obtain the preceding 88- or 93-day sum; then compare both resulting pair totals to BSB c539 four-place glyphs.
method_and_firewall.nonindependence: The two G893 six-place sequences are both from ONE G893 physical copy, not two independent ancient witnesses. BSB c539 is a distinct later received source object of another textual family; numerical compatibility alone does not prove an independent original mechanical calculation or a direct textual transmission edge.
method_and_firewall.chronology: G893 scan, BSB photographed 明史 source copy, textual work/edition and modern digital transcription remain distinct; the exact BSB impression date was not verified.

certificates.conditional_nonidentifiability: When independently coarsened to FOUR decimal degree places by half-up at the total, BOTH distinct existing six-place G893 data families produce all FOUR BSB original source values. Thus these four lower precision numbers alone cannot decide whether the six-place prose totals arose from printed daily J sums or from a separate higher-precision route.
certificates.other_rounder_matters: Simple truncation of six-place prose gives 4/4 BSB matches; truncation of printed daily J sums gives only 1/4. This difference rules out only that explicitly fixed truncation comparator, NOT the latter family under round-half-up or the actual historical BSB printing mechanism.

adjudication.positive: 4-of-4 exact double fit under round-half-up; period BSB four-place controls are precision-insufficient for a six-place origin decision even with a matching hypothetical elapsed-day window.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Numerically matching 4dp 明史 accumulations do not distinguish either six-place G893 calculation path and cannot be treated as a new independent source for the G893 prose aggregate or its 少/微 radix.
unresolved_lineage_questions: What physical 15th-century or earlier same-field original exposes carry/precision and how, if at all, were six-place post-table values generated?

next: Seek original G893 same-field native 少/微 carry or genuinely independent earlier higher precision/aggregate source. Do not re-collate 13SM J/S or count later rounded-four-place matches as six-place precision witnesses.
